entries.name: David Eberhardt

expected.charges: Federal mutilation of government records (18 USC 2071), interference with Selective Service System — Baltimore Four blood-pouring action.
expected.sentence: 2 years federal prison; served 21 months at USP Lewisburg.

updates.sentence:
2 years federal prison; served 21 months at USP Lewisburg.

Originally sentenced to three years on May 24, 1968; the case was later remanded for reconsideration of the sentences. After appellate bail and a period underground, taken into custody April 21, 1970. Eberhardt reported 21 months served in a 2020 Pratt Library interview. Exact final release date remains unverified.

entries.reason: Court chronology establishes October 27, 1967 action/arrest, not October 26 preparation; contemporary May 24 report establishes sentencing. The Witness documents April 21, 1970 capture after appellate bail. Replace false four-year continuous custody and unsupported April 14, 1972 endpoint with self-reported 21 months. His wife recalls 18 months in StoryCorps; preserve this discrepancy in audit and do not infer exact release from either total. Original three-year sentence was later reported as two years; exact reduction date unresolved.

Custody was interrupted by bail. Arrested in Cleveland October 12, 1961. A contemporary April 1, 1963 report records release March 14 and renewed detention March 22, 1963. A January 27, 1964 report records release on bond January 18, following extradition January 10. Appellate bond is also documented in the 1965 court record. A complete set of custody endpoints remains unresolved.

entries.reason: Correct arrest to October 12, 1961; remove false uninterrupted September 1961-December 1969 incarceration. Contemporary accounts establish multiple bail gaps in 1963/1964 and court confirms appellate bond; neither conviction reversal nor dismissal is a physical release date. Preserve known transitions in case narrative while complete intervals remain unresolved. No biography changes.
